title: Whiskerlight, the Lighthouse Cat
style: Hand-painted storybook gouache illustrations with soft texture, warm golden palette, and gentle twilight mood.
character: Whiskerlight is a small gray tabby cat with bright green eyes, a white chin, and a brass bell tied to a red ribbon.

pages.text: At the edge of the sea, a lighthouse keeper kept his lantern steady—and his friend Whiskerlight kept watch. When the waves went quiet, Whiskerlight listened for lonely ships calling from the dark.
pages.scene: A lighthouse tower glows softly as Whiskerlight perches on the railing, her brass bell catching moonlight while the ocean stretches in shadow.

pages.text: One stormy night, a ship’s signal flickered and faltered beyond the rocks. Whiskerlight padded along the iron stairs, pushed the keeper’s brass compass, and meowed until the lantern turned true.
pages.scene: Inside the lantern room, the keeper hurries while Whiskerlight nudges a compass on a table as lightning flashes and the beacon sweeps toward the safer path.

pages.text: Far below, Whiskerlight’s bell chimed in the wind, like a tiny guiding star. The ship followed the bright arc, and the rocks stayed hidden in mist.
pages.scene: In the storm, a distant ship steers through fog as Whiskerlight stands at an open window, bell swinging, while the lighthouse beam draws a protective curve.

pages.text: When morning arrived, the ship’s lights faded into grateful waves—and Whiskerlight curled by the warm lantern. The keeper smiled and said, “Home is never far, when you have a guide.”
pages.scene: Sunrise spills across calm water as Whiskerlight sleeps by the lighthouse door, and the sea reflects the fading golden beam.
